page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column, full width. A bracketed diagram of garments (Tunicae, Femoralia) sits in the text block with a label "Communes autem sunt" beside it. Marginal references are inline. Running head at top right; page number top left.

main_text.p: Vestiendi ratio, erat sacerdotibus vestes sacras, pro cuiusq; differentia imponendi ratio. Leu.8.7.8.9.13.
Vestes sacrae, sunt vestes ex Dei praescripto sanctae; ad gloriam & ornatum sacerdotum. Exod. 28.2.40.
Significabant Christi gloriam & ornatum, ex donis spiritus primo : & postea nostram quam in eo obtinemus. Zach.5.4.5.Psal.45.5.8.9.10.11.Esa.61.3.& 62.1.2.3.4.5.6.7.8.9.
main_text.l: Femoralia a lumbis ad ima feminae ad tegendam nudam carnem. Ex. 28.43.44.
main_text.p: Ad sacrificia actiones pertinentes (praeter communia officia offerentium vt manibus sacrificia niterentur) actiones sunt omnes ipsius consecrati. Exod.28.15.16.17.18.19.20.21.26.27.28.29.&c.
main_text.l: Sunt praeter communia Sacrificantium, huiusmodi sacrificia
main_text.p: Specialis sanguinis impositio erat, in qua ex arietis secundi sanguine accipiens, impcsuit sacerdotum auriculis infimis, dextris, & pollici dextrae, & pedis pollici dextrae; deinde sparsit reliquum sanguinis super altare circumquaque. Leu.8.23.24.

page.notes: Diagram brackets rendered as lines; the marginal "ibid. ver. 23.30." and bracket labels are side notes. Some words in the diagram are uncertain due to scan quality. The word "impcsuit" is printed as such.
